name: Course of Action
body:
Design revelation (thought) [language-dependent, mind-affecting]; Level 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 min./level or 1 round/level (D); see text
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You control an opponent’s thoughts to determine its next action, as the spell command, except as noted here.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, you may target an additional creature. No two targets may be more than 30 feet apart. All targets must follow the same course of action. In addition, for every two revelation charges used, the DC increases by +1.
